title: Review blocker: a crashed stage agent holds the turn-end judgement forever
context: Review of hud-live-run-truth found a blocker (src/stage-evidence/completion-deferred.ts:93). If a stage agent writes its started row and then dies without a SubagentStop, the turn-end judgement is deferred forever: no clock, and no later prompt, stage_end, re-dispatch or later stage row releases it (reproduced at +30 days). The change is then never judged, receipted or shown red, which breaks INV-2 and AC-4. Three deterministic releases fit the spec: a stage_end of that stage, a newer agent or stage_start after it, or a new host session (SessionStart). One case is left: an agent killed inside a live session with no SubagentStop. The spec does not cover it: FR-1 forbids reading an empty background_tasks list as release, and NFR-6 forbids a clock. Choose how far the fix goes.

options.label: Fix with the in-spec releases (stage_end, newer agent or stage, SessionStart). Record the in-session kill as tech debt; it is released by the next stage row or session.
